correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs composition on the published endomorphism normal form. Idempotence forces the unit exponent to be idempotent modulo \(N\), the valuation multiplier to be either preservation or total collapse, and in the preserving branch the parameter condition is exactly \(r^t=1\) modulo \(p^{e-1}\). Cyclic-unit counting and CRT give the formula; direct finite enumeration independently matches four cases.
